[P2] Use the same suspension boundary during adjudication

This accepts a timer completing after the SDK's `invocation_end(PENDING)` but before `wrapper_return`, as the new timer test explicitly permits. However, `replay()` still unconditionally calls `completed_suspension_checkpoint()`, which requires completion after `wrapper_return`. Because normalization preserves the service completion timestamp, an otherwise valid wait-only suspension fails adjudication as incomplete. Update the replay validator to use the proven SDK PENDING boundary consistently, and add an adjudication regression covering completion during wrapper teardown.
